title: stenophragma griffithianum
intro: Stenophragma griffithianum, commonly known as Griffith's Hook Cuscus Grass, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Eriocaulaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Asia, and is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Stenophragma griffithianum include its potential to treat various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as an anti-diarrheal agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
